readme.run: Measure neuron morphometrics and Sholl intersections from SWC reconstructions
notes: Input is one or more .swc files or a folder containing .swc files.
Pass --sholl-step N (default 10 um) or --no-repair. Add --help for every option.
Writes morphometrics, Sholl and bifurcation CSV tables, repaired SWCs, and provenance JSON.
No network connection is required and no external model files are downloaded.
Morphometric definitions follow NeuroM 4 (Blue Brain Project, EPFL).
Please cite Cannon et al. 1998 (SWC), Sholl 1953, and NeuroM.
